This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] who immigrated to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ayceezee]].<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> Sometime in [[39 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">[[Voort saBinring]] recalls that the incident occurred five standard [[Standard year|years]] before the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he attended [[Ayceezee Public College]] and attempted to murder [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Voort saBinring]] by launching himself over the professor's office desk. saBinring later learned that the student believed perfect scores were his birthright and attacked after receiving less than a perfect score. The professor subdued the him by knocking the wind out of him before returning him to his chair.<ref name="MK" />
